creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, Chat Notes 2026-10-07: "some sort of liveness or heartbeat check with telemetry debug if it catches things. for groups that lock up." Confirmed the same day: "I kind of observed a few times when it seems like agents in a group are waiting on each other or they just fail to kind of trigger the other one ... maybe having some sort of way to unlock this kind of situation or at least detect it."

So: notice a group whose members wait on each other, or whose post never triggered the member it was for; leave a diagnostic record in the run log; and where it can be done honestly, unlock it (re-ring a member whose wake never landed, tell whoever is waiting that the member it waits on has stopped). The stopped-reading card (a_2die6w7RD) is one cause.
title: 🔒 Notice, record and unlock a message group whose members wait on each other
